Subject: [Follow-up] Security & VPC discovery - SOC 2, SSQ initiation, deployment diagram

Hi Alice / Bob - thanks again for taking time earlier today. Quick follow-up from our call and agreed next steps so we can keep momentum:

Recap (high level):
- You're evaluating a private/VPC deployment of Redwood for sensitive PII workflows (GDPR + HIPAA considerations).
- Primary asks: SOC 2 status and evidence, vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) initiation, and a sample deployment diagram showing network isolation and air-gapped options.
- Timeline: target pilot in Q4 if SSQ + legal signoff align.

Action items I'll own:
1) Share our security overview + SOC 2 status and link to evidence (see attached Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf).
2) Kick off the SSQ template so your security team can start filling - attached SSQ_Initiation_ACME.xlsx.
3) Provide a sample VPC deployment diagram and short notes on air-gapped/on-prem options (attached deployment_diagram_vpc.png).

Action items for Acme:
- Confirm which compliance scope you'd like Redwood to demonstrate first (SOC 2 + GDPR mapping or SOC 2 + HIPAA).
- Share any internal SSQ deadlines and preferred format for evidence review.

Next meeting: can we do a 30-min technical follow-up next week focused on network topology and ingress/egress controls? I'll invite our solutions architect (Neha) if that works.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview.pdf, SSQ_Initiation_ACME.xlsx, deployment_diagram_vpc.png

Thanks -
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0146

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>

Cc: Bob Patel <bob.patel@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 16:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [Follow-up] Security & VPC discovery - SOC 2, SSQ initiation, deployment diagram

Thanks Marcus - really helpful recap. A few quick answers and clarifications from our side:

- Compliance scope: Please start with SOC 2 + GDPR mappings. HIPAA will follow if the pilot shows good results, but we need GDPR artifacts first for the EU subsample.
- SOC 2: We require the Type II report and the associated security control narrative. If you can provide the latest report and whether you have any SOC 2 bridge letters or exception notes, that would be ideal.
- SSQ: We'll begin with the attached SSQ template; I've reviewed your initiation sheet and will have our security SME start filling it out next week.
- Deployment diagram: The sample diagram you sent looks good. We'll want a version annotated with expected public/private subnets, NAT/GW usage, and any permitted egress endpoints for telemetry.

Yes - a 30-min tech follow-up next Tue (10/12) works. Please include Neha.

One more thing: can you confirm if you offer an air-gapped on-prem option for regulated customers, and if so, what the typical lead time and licensing model looks like?

Best,
Alice
Head of InfoSec Programs, Acme Corp
alice.chen@acme.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [Follow-up] Security & VPC discovery - SOC 2, SSQ initiation, deployment diagram

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Alice. A few replies inline and next steps:

- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II certified (Security + Availability). I've attached the high-level executive summary in the Security Overview PDF; for the full report we typically provide a secure access link and execute an NDA/controlled access workflow. I'll loop Legal if needed and share the access flow.

- Bridge letters / exceptions: We don't have active bridge letters for the current period. Any control exceptions historically are documented in the report; I'll note that in the access instructions.

- SSQ: Great - once you confirm the primary questions we'll prioritize answers for network, data residency, and key management sections.

- Deployment diagram: We'll produce a variant annotated with public/private subnets, NAT usage, transit gateways (if applicable), and explicit egress endpoints (telemetry, KMS endpoints, telemetry opt-out instructions). Expect the annotated diagram by EOD tomorrow.

- Air-gapped/on-prem option: Yes - Redwood offers an air-gapped on-prem deployment for regulated customers. Typical lead time is 8-12 weeks (procurement + engineering validation), and licensing is an enterprise private deployment contract (platform fee + support). We can provide a high level Statement of Work template if you want to evaluate internal procurement impact.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll upload a secure link to the SOC 2 evidence access flow and list required paperwork (NDA/controlled access) - target: today.
2) Send annotated deployment_diagram_vpc.png (EOD tomorrow).
3) Begin SSQ answers for high-priority sections (we'll tee up in HubSpot deal and track).

I'll schedule the 10/12 technical sync and include Neha.

Thanks -
Marcus
